Appendix 2: DE 1/11: Additional Procedure Codes of the Customs Declaration Service (CDS)

Find out the completion rules instructions for each 3-digit Union and National Additional Procedure Code that can be used in Data Element (DE) 1/11 for Imports.

From:
HM Revenue & Customs
Published:
1 August 2018
Last updated:
19 August 2026 — See all updates

Details

Known error workarounds may apply to this area of the instructions.

This Appendix contains the specific completion rules instructions for each 3-digit Union and National Additional Procedure Code that can be used in Data Element (DE) 1/11 for Imports.

This Appendix only contains any additional completion notes for each 3-digit Additional Procedure Code and does not constitute full guidance on how the declaration should be completed.

The completion notes in this Appendix are a supplement to the main CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Imports.

Where the DE 1/11 completion notes contain different instructions from the main Declaration Completion Guide or other Appendices, the completion instructions in Appendix 2 take precedence.

Where a single goods item requires the use of both Union and National Additional Procedure Codes, Union Codes should be declared first. See CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Imports, DE 1/11 for more details.

  1. 19 August 2026

    Amendments have been made throughout Additional Procedure Code C15 in the C Series.

  2. 30 July 2026

    Amendments have been made to various parts of the Import Additional Procedure Codes in relation to PVA01 and the removal of the PVA01 workaround. Completion instructions for Additional Procedure Code 2MO have been updated to highlight that if a commodity code doesn’t permit use of preference code 140, then preference code 100 can be used instead, and the non-preferential customs duty will be relieved.

  3. 1 July 2026

    Updates have been made to the Import C and F series Additional Procedure Codes to reflect that from 4 July, EU EORI's can be declared in certain data elements.

  4. 18 June 2026

    Correction has been made in the ‘Additional Declaration Type B or E (DE 1/2) Modified I1 Data Set’ for C07.

  5. 12 June 2026

    Additional Procedure Codes A04, F15, F44, 000, 1VW, 2CD and 2CG have been updated to reflect ‘Requested Procedure 78: Release to a Free Zone/Freeport’ being added to the CDS Declaration Completion Instructions for Imports. Completion requirements for Additional Procedure Code 1RV has been updated to state that it is not permitted to be used as a means of VAT zero rating goods or for claiming relief under The Chicago Convention. Additional Procedure Code 1TO has been updated to remove references to Excise Movement Control System (EMCS) which are not appropriate to this APC. Document Identifier field has been updated on multiple Additional Procedure Codes where reference to Document code 9WKS is made.

  6. 29 April 2026

    Additional Procedure Code 1RV has been updated to show it is eligible for use when Additional Information Code VATIC is declared in Data Element 2/2. Additional Procedure Code 2MO has been updated to show that it can be used with F-35 Military Authorised-Use Imports under International Collaboration Defence Arrangement (ICDA).

  7. 21 April 2026

  8. 2 April 2026

    Additional Procedure Code 1RC has been updated to prohibit use for claiming relief under the Chicago Convention and direct declarants to Additional Procedure Code 1CC instead.

    VAT Notes guidance for C23 and C25 have been updated. APC notes for C28, C54 and C55 have been updated to show that document code 9AID is mandatory. APC notes for C30 have been updated to remove a blank section on Additional Information codes.

    Multiple amendments have been made to Procedures Code F-Series (Appendix 2A) and Code 1-Series (Appendix 2B) to clarify that only status code ‘AC’ can be used with document code ‘9WKS’.
